techDesc.react: My primary library for building reactive, component-based user interfaces. Used across all my modern frontend projects.
techDesc.typescript: A typed superset of JavaScript that improves maintainability and catches errors at compile time. Foundation of my current frontend work.
techDesc.javascript: The fundamental language of the web. Used in both frontend and backend (Node.js) and in scripting projects.
techDesc.java: Primary language for enterprise backend development. Used with Spring Boot to build robust and scalable REST APIs.
techDesc.springBoot: Java framework for production-ready backend applications. Used in Genius Platform for REST APIs and microservice architecture.
techDesc.nodejs: JavaScript runtime for server-side development. Used to build fast APIs and real-time backend services.
techDesc.express: Minimalist framework for Node.js. Enables quick and flexible REST API construction with customizable middleware.
techDesc.tailwind: Utility-first CSS framework for building modern, responsive designs directly in markup.
techDesc.vite: Ultra-fast modern bundler with instant HMR. My preferred build tool for React projects.
techDesc.html5: Standard markup language of the web. Foundation of every user interface with modern semantic elements.
techDesc.css3: Stylesheet technology that brings interfaces to life. I use CSS variables, animations, and advanced responsive design.
techDesc.postgresql: Robust open-source relational database. Used in production for projects with complex data and relational structures.
techDesc.mongodb: Document-oriented NoSQL database. Ideal for flexible data and applications with dynamic schemas.
techDesc.supabase: Backend-as-a-Service platform built on PostgreSQL. Used for authentication, storage, and real-time database features.
techDesc.docker: Container platform for packaging and deploying applications consistently across any environment.
techDesc.git: Distributed version control system. Core part of my workflow across every project.
techDesc.github: Code hosting and collaboration platform. Used for version control, CI/CD pipelines, and project management.
techDesc.aws: Amazon cloud platform. Experience with core deployment and storage services.
techDesc.vercel: Deployment platform for modern frontend applications. Ideal for React projects with continuous integration.
techDesc.swagger: Tool for designing, documenting, and testing REST APIs. Integrated with Spring Boot for automatic documentation.
techDesc.postman: HTTP client for testing and documenting APIs. Essential in the backend development cycle.
techDesc.python: General-purpose language used in scripting, automation, and messaging system projects.
techDesc.cpp: Low-level language used in academic projects involving data structures, algorithms, and systems programming.
techDesc.go: Compiled language from Google, designed for concurrent systems and high-performance services. Actively learning.

site.bio:
I'm Cristian Barreiro, a Full-Stack developer and IT Technologist student, with training in Computer Technology High School and experience developing software solutions.

I specialize in building web applications, APIs, and digital systems, working with technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, Node.js, and SQL/NoSQL databases. Throughout my training, I have developed my own and academic projects, participating in the design, development, and implementation of complete solutions from start to finish.

I have experience working with agile methodologies, version control, and development best practices, collaborating in teams where planning, communication, and delivering results were essential. I also develop independent projects, exploring new tools and technologies to create efficient solutions tailored to real needs.

My focus is on transforming ideas and problems into functional digital products, combining development, continuous learning, and technical judgment to build quality solutions.
